ada-py-core.note: ada-py is the published PyPI distribution built from the same adapy upstream; the synthesized ada-py-core project does not exist on PyPI.

cmake-format.note: cmakelang and cmake-format 0.6.13 resolve to the same upstream release; unrelated helper distributions found in the artifact are excluded.

open3d.note: open3d-cpu is the CPU-only PyPI distribution of the same Open3D release and upstream source.

py-opencv.note: The opencv-python wheel variants distribute the same OpenCV Python bindings; both GUI and headless PyPI identities are retained.

python-wasmer-compiler-llvm.note: Reviewed against the Wasmer Python upstream; the bundled singlepass distribution is a separate compiler backend.

python-wasmer-compiler-singlepass.note: Reviewed against the Wasmer Python upstream; the bundled cranelift distribution is a separate compiler backend.
